[[Rokur Gepta]] fed his [[Rokur Gepta's pets|pets]] a certain kind of animal for their food. They were very much like [[Mouse/Legends|mice]], with pelts of curly golden fur, large blue eyes, and bushy tails. They were sleek, clean, and radiated warmth, and let out squeaks when in pain or distressed. They made Gepta shudder, and he fed them to his pets alive.
